name: Oficina API — Operação
description: Ordens de serviço, integrações, latência das APIs e recursos do Kubernetes (Tech Challenge Fase 3)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM Log WHERE event = 'service_order.created' SINCE today

widgets.title: Volume diário de ordens de serviço

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS abertas' FROM Log WHERE event = 'service_order.created' FACET dateOf(timestamp) SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 31

widgets.title: Tempo médio por status (minutos) — diagnóstico, execução, finalização

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(numeric(duration_minutes)) AS 'minutos' FROM Log WHERE event = 'service_order.status_changed' FACET from_status SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'service_order.status_changed' FACET to_status TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS 'falhas', latest(timestamp) AS 'última' FROM Log WHERE event = 'service_order.failed' FACET action, error SINCE 24 hours ago

widgets.title: Erros e falhas nas integrações (Resend, BrasilAPI)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'integration.error' FACET integration TIMESERIES 30 minutes SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(numeric(latency_ms), 50, 95, 99) FROM Log WHERE event = 'http.request' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req/min' FROM Log WHERE event = 'http.request' SINCE 30 minutes ago
SELECT average(numeric(latency_ms)) AS 'ms' FROM Log WHERE event = 'http.request' FACET method, route SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE event = 'http.request' FACET status TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 3 hours ago

widgets.title: Traces — duração média por rota (spans de servidor)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration.ms) AS 'ms' FROM Span WHERE service.name LIKE 'oficina-api%' AND span.kind = 'server' FACET http.route SINCE 3 hours ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: Traces — tempo em banco de dados (ms)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration.ms) AS 'ms' FROM Span WHERE service.name LIKE 'oficina-api%' AND db.system.name = 'postgresql' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 3 hours ago
SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-api-homolog') FACET podName TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) / 1048576 AS 'MiB' FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('oficina-api', 'oficina-api-homolog') FACET podName TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT latest(desiredReplicas) AS 'desejadas', latest(currentReplicas) AS 'atuais' FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE namespaceName = 'oficina-api' TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) / average(allocatableCpuCores) * 100 AS '% CPU' FROM K8sNodeSample FACET nodeName TIMESERIES 1 minute SINCE 1 hour ago
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE result = 'SUCCESS') AS 'uptime %' FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName = 'oficina-api-health' SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration) AS 'ms' FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName = 'oficina-api-health' TIMESERIES 5 minutes SINCE 6 hours ago
